_comment: EXPLICIT DIAGNOSTIC-ONLY override. This file is never used by standard CI, release, fetch, or verify paths. It packages the owner-supplied fine-tuned MMS files only when an operator deliberately passes --config src-tauri/tauri.finetuned.conf.json for an isolated benchmark build. Production drafting and every standard installer remain WSL7B-only. Tauri replaces resource arrays when merging, so the complete runtime-support list is repeated here.
